title: 5.4.2.4 SPs on the TPer Group - SP (Object Table)

content.text:
The table in this section describes the data that the Admin SP keeps about all of the SPs on the TPer.
The Admin SP SHALL be UID=0x00 0x00 0x02 0x05 0x00 0x00 0x00 0x01 in the SP Table, and the
values in this table SHALL be readable by the Anybody authority.

tables.title: Table 215 SP Table Description
tables.table_md:
| Column Number | Column Name | IsUnique | Column Type |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| 0x00 | UID | | uid |
| 0x01 | Name | Yes | name |
| 0x02 | ORG | | Authority_object_ref |
| 0x03 | EffectiveAuth | | max_bytes_32 |
| 0x04 | DateOfIssue | | date |
| 0x05 | Bytes | | uinteger_8 |
| 0x06 | LifeCycleState | | life_cycle_state |
| 0x07 | Frozen | | boolean_def_false |
